module "ExternSelection.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiExternSelection" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0.25)) : float3 @L30:C18 "i"
  %1 = FunctionCall[Path(Game, "Functions/MF_LiSplit")](Colour=%0, DeclaredInputs="[Colour, Gain]", FunctionPath="Path(Game, \"Functions/MF_LiSplit\")") : [A:float3, B:float] @L31:C19 "x"

  sink %3
